sentences.en: These are the Faces of Evil. You must conquer each.
sentences.zh: 这些都是邪恶的面孔。你必须征服每一个。

sentences.en: The city was conquered, and he was driven out.
sentences.zh: 这座城市被攻占了，他被迫离开了。

sentences.en: The soldiers seized food from the people they conquered.
sentences.zh: 士兵们从被征服的人们那里抢走了食物。

senses.zh: 攻克, 征服 - 破除, 克服 -
